bugs_found: compound_interest uses (principal + rate) instead of principal in the formula, producing inflated results
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int() instead of validating input
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing type errors or inconsistent money precision
transfer is not atomic: source balance is debited before destination credit, so a destination-side failure can lose funds
transfer does not validate account balances/currency fields, so malformed Account objects can corrupt state
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
fx_convert does not validate that FX rate is positive, so zero or negative rates can silently erase or invert money
